notes.title: New update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35069242/4f8b88c32b4f8d5b724c870c1d498317cd0a461a.png[/img]

Actually, no changes have been made to the main game, but there has been an update in the local folder.
(From the right-click menu of the Steam game list, click [Properties] -> [Local Files] -> [Browse] to check their location.)

 1. The KUMACURE_materials folder has been added. 　
The image resources used in this KumaCure are now available. 　
You can use them within the scope of [read me.txt], located in the same folder.

2. [sample]KUMA CURE_project.zip 　We have released the project data (basic part) of the limited version of KumaCure. Stage, equipment, etc. have been modified from the original version.
After unzipping the file, open it in Pixel Game Maker MV to see how to create a basic KumaCure stage!
